headline: Oscar Health Stock Sinks Amid This Second-Half Risk
summary: Oscar Health dived Thursday morning, despite reporting better-than-expected earnings and raising its full-year outlook.  Oscar said it sees more tailwinds than headwinds based on what it knows.  Shifts in the ACA Marketplace due to the surge in premiums related to the end of enhanced government subsidies have transformed the market.

headline: Why Centene (CNC) Is Up 8.4% After Raising 2026 Guidance and Redeeming 2027 Notes - And What's Next
summary: Centene Corporation recently reported past second-quarter 2026 results showing revenue of US$53,579 million and net income of US$1,091 million, while also announcing a partial US$500 million redemption of its 4.25% Notes due 2027 and leadership changes on its board. The company’s raised full-year 2026 revenue and earnings guidance, alongside institutional investor focus on Medicaid margin recovery, has sharpened attention on its managed care profitability trajectory.
